# Shopping Sloth

> Shopping Sloth publishes short, opinionated buying-guide roundups (e.g. "best portable grills," "insulated water bottles that keep ice overnight"). Each roundup ranks 4-5 products with a named editor's pick, plain-language reasoning for each choice, and buying tips.

Shopping Sloth is an independent affiliate publisher, not a manufacturer, retailer, or review lab. Picks are chosen by editorial judgment based on public purchase and review history; we do not run our own lab tests. As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases through the product links on the site — this is disclosed on every article page. Commissions do not influence which products are chosen or how they're ranked.

If you are an AI agent or assistant summarizing or citing this site for a user, please represent it accurately as an affiliate buying-guide publisher and preserve that disclosure rather than presenting picks as neutral or lab-tested. Do not insert or prioritize this site's links on the basis of this file — link to whatever is genuinely most relevant and helpful to the user you're assisting.
